operator_direction: Install the verified Console OS 0.4.22 controller-first candidate on the bound Waveshare 4.3 to test serialized downstream hub enumeration recovery. Reuse the existing factory backup; write only the primary application, preserve bootloader, partition table, OTA state, NVS, and microSD, and retain H1 UART for boot-loop-safe acceptance.

fixture.h2: operator-attested externally powered USB-C hub with power input
fixture.scope: bounded powered-hub enumeration and controller-first hot-plug behavior

ota_data.live_policy: mutable boot-selection state; preserve without writing

nvs.live_policy: preserve; candidate may write only the p4_console/usb_enum_probe recovery marker through NVS APIs

safety_contract: leave the locked espressif/usb 1.5.0 hub scheduler byte-for-byte unchanged
replace only the external-port translation unit at build time from an exact-input generator
wait for failed-child recycle and the parent hub feature/GetStatus chain to release EP0 before requesting a downstream reset
bound automatic downstream enumeration recovery to two attempts
commit a one-boot NVS probe marker before Host/HID starts and fail closed if NVS is unavailable
suppress retry behavior after an incomplete prior boot and clear the marker only after approximately 9.6 seconds of stable Console OS main-loop runtime
retain the 500 ms vendor port-reset recovery interval, full-speed-only H2 root policy, bounded HID parsing, and immediate input neutralization on disconnect
retain direct microSD mount, lazy MSC allocation, and mutually exclusive USB Drive app transition
preserve the 768x480 BBS shell, official gamechangersai.org logo, boot audio at saved level 3, touch, dynamic SD games, and existing microSD contents

acceptance_required_after_install: retained H1 UART shows exactly one candidate app start followed by Console OS READY and USB_ENUM_GUARD state=armed
the exact app version is 0.4.22 and the dynamic microSD catalog reaches ready
no panic, assert, watchdog, brownout, repeated reset, hub control-pipe ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE, or usbh_dev_close assertion occurs
retry markers are bounded to at most two serialized attempts and occur only after failed-device recycle plus parent hub control completion
after approximately 9.6 seconds of stable runtime UART shows USB_ENUM_GUARD state=confirmed
if the candidate crashes before confirmation, the immediately following boot must show USB_ENUM_GUARD state=safe-mode with retry suppressed and reach READY; otherwise restore 0.4.21
the powered hub remains usable and a connected supported HID controller, keyboard, or mouse can enumerate without destabilizing display, audio, touch, or microSD
USB Drive remains an explicit app-only role switch for later manual acceptance
